findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: NuGet lock files are not enabled or committed
findings.standard: NuGet: Enable repeatable package restores using a lock file (fallback rubric)
findings.recommendation: Add <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile> to Directory.Build.props, commit the generated packages.lock.json files, and use --locked-mode restores in CI.
